candidates.topic: The Voronezh Alien Encounter — Soviet Government Confirmed UFO Landing
candidates.teaser: The Soviet government once officially confirmed that an alien spacecraft landed in a public park — and named the witnesses.
candidates.video_title: The UFO Landing a Government Actually Confirmed
candidates.video_description: In 1989, Soviet state media TASS reported a UFO landing in Voronezh, Russia, witnessed by dozens of children and adults. Remarkably, the Soviet government never retracted the story. This remains one of the few alien encounter cases backed by official state sources.
candidates.script: A government once officially confirmed an alien spacecraft landed in a city park — and it wasn't a conspiracy theory. In 1989, Soviet state news agency TASS reported that a 9-foot alien stepped out of a craft in Voronezh, Russia, in front of dozens of witnesses. The Kremlin never retracted it. No other government on Earth has officially stood behind a story like this. So what exactly did they see?

candidates.topic: The Hottest Thing Ever Created by Humans
candidates.teaser: Scientists once created something 100,000 times hotter than the core of the Sun — right here on Earth.
candidates.video_title: The Hottest Thing Humans Have Ever Made
candidates.video_description: In 2012, physicists at CERN smashed lead ions together and created a quark-gluon plasma reaching 5.5 trillion degrees Celsius — dwarfing the Sun's 15-million-degree core. This recreated conditions from just microseconds after the Big Bang. The universe has never been this hot since then — until we made it.
candidates.script: In 2012, humans created something 100,000 times hotter than the Sun's core — inside a tunnel in Switzerland. Scientists at CERN collided lead ions so violently they produced a quark-gluon plasma at 5.5 trillion degrees Celsius. That temperature hasn't existed in the universe since one microsecond after the Big Bang. We literally recreated the birth of everything. The wildest part? It lasted for less than a blink.

candidates.topic: The Woman Who Felt No Fear — SM Patient Neuroscience
candidates.teaser: A woman known only as SM has never felt fear in her life — not from snakes, not from knives, not from anything.
candidates.video_title: The Woman Who Is Physically Unable to Feel Fear
candidates.video_description: A woman known only as 'SM' has a rare condition that destroyed her amygdala — the brain's fear center. She has been held at knifepoint, exposed to tarantulas, and walked through haunted houses, and felt nothing each time. Scientists have studied her for decades to understand what fear actually is.
candidates.script: A woman has been held at knifepoint, put face-to-face with tarantulas, and walked through extreme haunted houses — and never once felt fear. She's known only as SM, and a rare disease called Urbach-Wiethe destroyed her amygdala — the only part of your brain that generates fear. Scientists have studied her since the 1990s. She's curious about everything that should terrify her. Does that sound like a superpower or a nightmare to you?

candidates.topic: The Ocean's Midnight Zone — Pressure So Extreme Bullets Slow Down
candidates.teaser: At a certain depth in the ocean, the pressure is so intense it would crush a steel submarine like an empty can — and something lives there.
candidates.video_title: What Lives Where Pressure Crushes Steel
candidates.video_description: The Hadal zone, found in ocean trenches below 6,000 meters, generates pressure over 1,000 times greater than at the surface. A bullet fired there would slow to a halt within inches. Yet snailfish, amphipods, and microbes thrive in complete darkness at these extremes, rewriting our definition of where life is possible.
candidates.script: Six kilometers below the ocean surface, the pressure is so extreme that a bullet fired underwater would stop dead within inches. Steel crumples there like paper. And yet — snailfish thrive at the very bottom of the Mariana Trench, deeper than Mount Everest is tall, in total darkness and near-freezing water. We know more about the surface of Mars than we do about what lives down there. What else is hiding?

candidates.topic: The Sleeping Army — 8,000 Terracotta Warriors Buried With One Man
candidates.teaser: One man was so terrified of death that he built a secret underground army of 8,000 soldiers — and it stayed hidden for over 2,200 years.
candidates.video_title: 8,000 Soldiers Buried in Secret for 2,200 Years
candidates.video_description: China's first emperor, Qin Shi Huang, ordered the construction of a life-sized terracotta army of over 8,000 unique soldiers to guard him in the afterlife. Buried in 210 BC, the army was discovered entirely by accident in 1974 by farmers digging a well. No two faces among the 8,000 figures are identical.
candidates.script: In 210 BC, an emperor was buried with an army of 8,000 soldiers — each one life-sized, each face completely unique, none of them real. Qin Shi Huang, China's first emperor, ordered thousands of craftsmen to build him a terracotta legion to guard him in the afterlife. It stayed sealed underground for 2,200 years until a farmer accidentally hit one with a shovel in 1974. Experts believe the innermost chamber still hasn't been opened.
